name: Literate Agda
reason: The pinned Literate Agda row groups its sole .lagda source form with Agda. Its only specimen embeds the same Agda code as the plain fixture after trimming outer newlines. Agda 2.8.0 documents .lagda as literate TeX source with delimited Agda code. The association is to Agda for that source form. The TeX carrier and rendering have separate roles.
